premise: Gallimimus and Spinosaurus race to the giant lily pads where Ammonite waits; Gallimimus dashes all the way round the edge of the lagoon, but Spinosaurus wades in, sweeps his paddle tail and swims straight across — then shakes himself dry all over the runner-up.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Tortoise and the Hare' turned: the slow walker is a fast swimmer — every racer is fastest somewhere.
learning: Spinosaurus swam with a long tail shaped like a paddle.

en-US.title: The Lily Pad Race
en-US.text: [excited] Out by the giant lily pads, {ammonite:enter} {ammonite:go to lagoon} Ammonite {ammonite:live wave-tentacles} waved her curly tentacles. "Race you to me!" {gallimimus:enter} {gallimimus:go to shore} {gallimimus:face happy} Gallimimus, the fastest runner in the valley, ran down to the shore {gallimimus:live ready-set hold} and crouched, ready to go. {spinosaurus:enter} {spinosaurus:go to gallimimus} Spinosaurus came plodding up beside her. [playfully] "You're much too slow," she teased. {spinosaurus:face happy} "We'll see," said Spinosaurus. Ready… steady… GO! {gallimimus:live ready-set resume} {gallimimus:go to ammonite} Whoosh! Off ran Gallimimus, all the way round the edge of the lagoon. But Spinosaurus {spinosaurus:go to ammonite by swim} waded straight into the water, {spinosaurus:live paddle-tail} {sfx:paddle} swept his long tail like a paddle, swish, swoosh, and swam right across. He got there first! {ammonite:live spin} Ammonite twirled for the winner. {gallimimus:face surprised} [surprised] Gallimimus came puffing up. "But… HOW?" {spinosaurus:go to gallimimus} Spinosaurus climbed out beside her and {spinosaurus:live shake-off} {sfx:shake} shook himself dry. Wiggle, wiggle, SPLASH! {gallimimus:spray} {gallimimus:face happy} [laughs] Gallimimus was dripping from her beak to the tip of her tail. "Tomorrow," she laughed, "we race on land!" {spinosaurus:wobble} "And then," said Spinosaurus, "we swim back."

es-ES.title: La carrera de los nenúfares
es-ES.text: [excited] Junto a los nenúfares gigantes, {ammonite:enter} {ammonite:go to lagoon} Amonites {ammonite:live wave-tentacles} saludaba con sus tentáculos rizados. —¡A ver quién llega antes hasta mí! {gallimimus:enter} {gallimimus:go to shore} {gallimimus:face happy} Gallimimus, la corredora más rápida del valle, bajó a la orilla de una carrera {gallimimus:live ready-set hold} y se agachó, lista para salir. {spinosaurus:enter} {spinosaurus:go to gallimimus} Espinosaurio llegó a su lado, pasito a pasito. [playfully] —Eres demasiado lento —le dijo ella, de broma. {spinosaurus:face happy} —Ya veremos —dijo Espinosaurio. Preparados… listos… ¡YA! {gallimimus:live ready-set resume} {gallimimus:go to ammonite} ¡Fiuuu! Gallimimus salió disparada, bordeando toda la laguna. Pero Espinosaurio {spinosaurus:go to ammonite by swim} se metió en el agua sin pensárselo, {spinosaurus:live paddle-tail} {sfx:paddle} movió su larga cola como un remo, chis, chas, y cruzó nadando en línea recta. ¡Llegó el primero! {ammonite:live spin} Amonites dio una vuelta para el ganador. {gallimimus:face surprised} [surprised] Gallimimus llegó resoplando. —Pero… ¿CÓMO? {spinosaurus:go to gallimimus} Espinosaurio salió del agua, se puso a su lado y {spinosaurus:live shake-off} {sfx:shake} se sacudió. ¡Meneo, meneo, y CHOF! {gallimimus:spray} {gallimimus:face happy} [laughs] Gallimimus quedó chorreando del pico a la punta de la cola. —Mañana —dijo, partiéndose de risa— corremos por tierra. {spinosaurus:wobble} —Y luego —dijo Espinosaurio— volvemos nadando.
